query:
UPDATE activities
                    SET customer_id = $2, contact_id = $3, rep_id = $4,
                        activity_date = $5::text::timestamptz,
                        activity_type = $6, subject = $7, details = $8,
                        follow_up_date = $9::text::date,
                        completed = $10, version = version + 1
                  WHERE id = $1
                 RETURNING id, version
